title: Percussion one-shot synthesis parameters
description: Synthesis parameters for one deterministic percussion one-shot (v0.1, proposal, #475, D-032). Mono. Only schema_version and seed are required; an omitted field takes the default named in its description. Out-of-range values are rejected, never clamped. One shared parameter space for five models (`model`: conga, tom, shaker, cowbell, clave); a model selects the voice structure and its BASE VALUES (pitch, decay, attack; table in $comment point 2), never which fields exist. Pitch, decay and attack are given RELATIVE to the model's base values (tune_semitones, decay_scale, attack_scale), so one default per field fits every model. Time t is measured from the first sample of the sound (sample n_off with offset_ms). All base values, ranges and defaults are PROPOSALS: the few numbers with a source are prior art from one browser artifact (docs/research/2026-10-29_bandit-wheel-synthesis-transfer.md section 5: tom/conga glide 1.25 / 1.3 with time constant 7 / 4 ms, 6 ms noise tick through a 2.5 kHz band-pass, cowbell squares 540 + 800 Hz through a 2.6 kHz band-pass, clave 2.4 kHz, shaker band-pass 4.5 kHz with a 3 kHz high-pass and a 12 ms attack); no outside source gives numeric targets for techno percussion (docs/research/2026-11-02_toms-percs-and-sidechain-feasibility.md section 1); they are placeholders until the audio-engineer measures them and the user listens. The audio-engineer may adjust them in the engine PR (a contract-change then). Toms are a model here, never the default (D-032: only presets explicitly named for hard groove use them). Not part of v0.1: bongo (conga with tune_semitones +12), tambourine, FM bell / metal, ride (hat-params territory), a second membrane mode, a note-name or key resolver, per-hit round robin, stereo.
$comment: Contract rules that JSON Schema cannot express or that are not field ranges. (1) Pitch: f0 = base_hz[model] * 2^(tune_semitones / 12). (2) Base values per model (placeholders; source in brackets): tom: base_hz 130.81 (C3, the artifact puts its tom in octave 3), base_decay_ms 300 (placeholder), base_attack_ms 0.6 (artifact); conga: base_hz 261.63 (C4, placeholder, no source for the conga octave), base_decay_ms 200 (placeholder), base_attack_ms 0.6 (artifact); cowbell: base_hz 540 (artifact lower square), base_decay_ms 120 (artifact 120 ms duration, read here as time to -60 dB), base_attack_ms 1 (artifact); clave: base_hz 2400 (artifact), base_decay_ms 30 (artifact 'decay 30'), base_attack_ms 0.5 (placeholder); shaker: base_hz 4500 (artifact band-pass centre), base_decay_ms 80 (placeholder), base_attack_ms 12 (artifact). The attack is attack_ms = base_attack_ms * attack_scale, the decay is t60 = base_decay_ms * decay_scale. (3) Voices. `tom` and `conga` (membrane): one sine, phase 0 at t = 0, with instantaneous frequency f(t) = f0 * (1 + (bend_ratio - 1) * exp(-t / bend_ms)); the phase is the integral of f. tom and conga share this structure in v0.1 and differ only by their base values. `cowbell`: two band-limited squares at f0 and f0 * 800 / 540, equal amplitude, start phase 0, each with all odd harmonics k with k * f < sample_rate / 2 (the rule of audio_engine.dsp.square_bank), then an RBJ band-pass with 0 dB peak gain at 2600 * 2^(tune_semitones / 12) Hz, Q 1.4. `clave`: one sine at f0, phase 0 (the rim voice with a single partial). `shaker`: seeded white noise, RBJ band-pass with 0 dB peak gain at f0, Q 1.5, then a 2nd-order high-pass at 3000 * 2^(tune_semitones / 12) Hz. bend_ratio and bend_ms act only on tom and conga; tick_level and tick_hz have no effect at shaker; hp_hz (at most 1000) lies below the shaker's own high-pass, so its effect there is small. (4) Envelope: a linear ramp from 0 to 1 over attack_ms from the first sample, then exponential decay; t60 is the time from the end of the attack until the envelope has fallen 60 dB (time to -60 dB after the attack), same definition as kick amp_decay_ms, hat decay_ms and rim decay1_ms. The voice has amplitude 1 at the end of the attack before filtering. (5) Tick: tick_level 0 means no tick. The tick is white noise from its own sub-stream of the seed, RBJ band-pass with 0 dB peak gain at tick_hz, Q 1.2, with an exponential decay of 6 ms to -60 dB from t = 0, scaled by tick_level relative to the voice amplitude 1. (6) hp_hz: a 2nd-order high-pass on the whole signal (voice plus tick) before drive; 20 = off (no filter), the same definition as laser-params v0.2 hp_hz. No cross-field rule: a high hp_hz thins a low tom (the lowest f0 is 65.4 Hz) but never removes the whole signal, and the peak ceiling restores the level; rejecting it would gate a result the user may want. (7) Highest frequency: the membrane start f0 * bend_ratio is at most 261.63 * 2 * 2 = 1046.5 Hz, the cowbell upper square at most 1600 Hz with its band-pass at most 5200 Hz, the clave at most 4800 Hz, the shaker band-pass at most 9000 Hz and its high-pass at most 6000 Hz, the tick at most 6000 Hz; all are below 0.45 * 44100 = 19845 Hz, so no cross-field rule is needed for aliasing; drive uses the kick's anti-aliased saturation. (8) Determinism: same resolved parameters (including seed) give a byte-identical WAV. The seed feeds the tick and the shaker noise, each from its own sub-stream; tom, conga, cowbell and clave at tick_level 0 are seed-independent; shaker is always seed-dependent. (9) Reject out-of-range values, never clamp. Defaults are placeholders until measured. The default model is conga, not tom (D-032). (10) The file ends with a 5 ms linear fade-out like the kick, the first sample is 0, DC is removed as in clap; the peak ceiling holds for the quantised file. length_ms: a given length_ms shorter than the sound cuts it with the fade; if omitted the engine chooses at least offset_ms + attack_ms + t60 + 5 ms and records the chosen value in the sidecar. (11) Sidecar features are the existing non-pitched ones for every model; whether tom and conga also report a tail pitch (fundamental_hz) is decided by the engine PR (a contract-change then). Shared field names keep the meaning of clap-params, hat-params, laser-params and kick-params (seed, variants, bpm, sample_rate, bit_depth, length_ms, drive, polarity, offset_ms, peak_ceiling_dbfs, preset, hp_hz). Engine identity for sidecars: engine.name 'abeltongod-audio-engine-perc' with the perc engine's own version (sample-metadata.schema.json, D-025).

seed.description: Seeds the tick and the shaker noise (own sub-streams). Tom, conga, cowbell and clave are seed-independent at tick_level 0. Same parameters and seed give a byte-identical WAV.

length_ms.description: File length. Omitted = chosen by the engine (at least offset_ms + attack + t60 + the 5 ms fade) and recorded in the sidecar. If shorter than the sound, it is cut off with a 5 ms fade-out.

model.description: Voice structure and base values (contract $comment points 2 and 3). conga/tom = sine with a pitch glide, cowbell = two band-passed squares, clave = one sine, shaker = band-passed noise. Toms are never the default (D-032).

tune_semitones.description: Pitch relative to the model's base frequency, semitones (f0 = base_hz * 2^(tune_semitones / 12)). One octave each way: conga +12 is the bongo range, tom -12 / +12 spans 65.4 to 261.6 Hz. Shaker: moves its band-pass and high-pass.

decay_scale.description: Time to fall 60 dB after the attack, as a multiple of the model's base decay (tom 300, conga 200, cowbell 120, clave 30, shaker 80 ms; placeholders). Two octaves each way.

attack_scale.description: Linear attack time as a multiple of the model's base attack (tom and conga 0.6, cowbell 1, clave 0.5, shaker 12 ms). Two octaves each way; the shortest attack is 0.125 ms (clave at 0.25).

bend_ratio.description: Start frequency / end frequency of the membrane glide (tom, conga only; no effect for the other models). 1 = no glide. Artifact prior art 1.25 (tom) and 1.3 (conga); its replaced long tom used 1.7, inside the range.

bend_ms.description: Time constant of the exponential glide toward f0, ms (tom, conga only). No effect at bend_ratio 1. Artifact prior art 7 ms (tom) and 4 ms (conga).

tick_level.description: Level of the band-passed noise tick relative to the voice. 0 = off (then tom, conga, cowbell and clave are seed-independent). No effect at shaker. Artifact prior art 0.15 (tom) and 0.3 (conga).

tick_hz.description: Centre of the tick band-pass, Hz (Q 1.2). No effect at tick_level 0 or at shaker. Artifact prior art 2500 Hz.

hp_hz.description: High-pass cutoff on the whole signal, Hz. 20 = off. Same definition as laser-params v0.2 hp_hz.

drive.description: Anti-aliased saturation, same stage as kick drive. 0 = off.

polarity.description: Sign of the whole output, applied after the peak ceiling.

offset_ms.description: Silence before the sound, rounded to whole samples (as in kick-params).

peak_ceiling_dbfs.description: Peak ceiling of the quantised file.

preset.description: Name of the preset these values came from, if any.
